name: Solitaire Lodge
positioning: Full-board luxury lodge on a private peninsula over Lake Tarawera near Rotorua, with views towards the volcanic craters of Mount Tarawera
best_for: Travelers who want a secluded lake setting with kayaks and dinghies included and hot springs, waterfall walks and helicopter trips nearby
Families or groups wanting a stand-alone one- or two-bedroom suite

facts.text: The suites have floor-to-ceiling windows and private balconies looking over Lake Tarawera.
The lodge has views over Lake Tarawera towards the volcanic craters of Mount Tarawera.
The full board tariff includes a complimentary mini bar, pre-dinner drinks and canapes, a five-course evening meal, full country breakfast and light lunch.
The chefs create daily changing menus with a seasonal New Zealand focus.
Use of the lodge's dinghies, kayaks and safety equipment is included in the stay.
The lodge has a private helipad and a private jetty.
Guests can take a helicopter trip to the summit of Mount Tarawera.
Guests can take a private 4WD and hike to the 1111m summit of Mount Tarawera.
The Tarawera Falls Walk is a half-day experience that starts with a short speedboat transfer to the Tarawera outlet stream.
The stand-alone Villa Suite comes in one- or two-bedroom configurations and is described as ideal for families, groups or couples wanting space.
The Villa Suite's master ensuite has a freestanding bath overlooking the lake.
Solitaire Lodge was awarded a Michelin Key for 2026.

highlights.text: Solitaire Lodge sits on a private peninsula over Lake Tarawera, with a natural bush setting and a volcanic backdrop.
A 15-minute private launch excursion reaches the natural hot springs of Lake Tarawera.
Guests can paddle the protected waters of the Otumutu Lagoon, home to ancient Maori sites.
The Solitaire Suite is set in a separate building, with one or two bedrooms and picture windows looking across Lake Tarawera towards Mount Tarawera.
Guests can swim or picnic at a private secluded beach on the lodge's peninsula.

considerations.text: Guests should contact the lodge hosts for cost and availability of the suggested experiences and excursions.
Additional alcoholic beverages are added to the guest bill.
WhataHotel notes the secluded location requires planning for outside dining and activities.
